messages:
maya: Quick design review — thinking about progressive disclosure in the invite + roles flow. Proposal: hide advanced role matrix behind a chevron and show a compact summary by default (role badges + count). Goal: reduce cognitive load for small org admins.

sam: Love the idea. Can we keep one-click access to the full matrix? i.e., a `View full roles` link right next to the chevron so power users don't hunt. :+1:

jordan: Concern: hiding the matrix might make audits harder — auditors often need to see inheritance/SSO mappings at a glance. Can we surface audit-relevant flags in the compact view? maybe small icons for SSO-enforced / org-default / inherited.

eli: A11y note: chevron-only disclosure needs an accessible label. Suggest `button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="roles-matrix"` and visible text fallback for screen readers: "Show role details". Also keyboard focus outline must be full-width in the invite panel.

ryan: Frontend nuance — the compact row is easy. But table rows that expand will shift layout. I'd prefer an accordion pattern inside a scrollable container to avoid jank. Also we should avoid animating height on large tables (perf).

maya: Good calls. For audit flags: what about microcopies like `SSO`/`Org default` that show hover tooltips with exact rule snippets. Tooltip text should include a short reason and a link to the audit log filter pre-applied.

sam: Copy tweak: instead of `SSO` on the badge, use `SSO enforced` for clarity. Short but clearer for non-technical admins. Tooltip: "Enforced by org SSO: members auto-assigned."

jordan: For the audit log link — can we pass a filter param so the audit page opens with the role and actor pre-filled? makes triage faster. UX: small icon that opens a preview modal before leaving the invite flow.

eli: Keyboard + SR flow: when opening matrix or audit preview modal, focus must land on the modal heading. Closing should restore focus to the original invite CTA. Also ensure role badges have `aria-label="Role: Admin — SSO enforced"` for clarity.

ryan: Implementation detail: the prefilled audit link will need a stable role id. Backend: will it be `role_id` or `slug`? prefer `role_id` to avoid display name drift. Frontend can fall back to slug if id missing.

maya: Action items: 1) update prototype with accordion + compact badges (sam) 2) add aria-labels & keyboard flow (eli) 3) prototype tooltip copy + audit preview modal (jordan) 4) infra check about role_id param (ryan). I'll push a new Figma frame later today and drop the link here.

design-bot: New frame uploaded: https://figma.com/file/xyz (version v3) — please comment on the right panel.

sam: I'll mock the badge states and the `View full roles` affordance. Quick question — should `View full roles` be primary or tertiary? leaning tertiary to keep invite CTA prominent.

jordan: Tertiary makes sense. We don't want to distract from completing invites. Also consider a subtle affordance to remind auditors that full view exists (small help text under the compact).

eli: Final a11y note: color contrast for the badge icons needs to meet AA. If we use colored chips, include an icon pattern as backup. Also avoid relying on color alone for `Org default` vs `Custom` distinction.

maya: Agreed. I'll include icon states in the Figma. Thanks, everyone — will post the updated frame and a short checklist for engineering handoff.
